review_pass_1: Internal scientific and syllabus review: checked roadmap and syllabus PDFs; primary records for Hayflick, Kenyon, Conboy, Hydra and comparative demography; 2013/2023 hallmarks and textbook references. Distinguished aging from senescence, lesions from mutation, autophagosome counts from flux, ATP stock from production, donor from environment, mortality proportion from survival. Recomputed numeric examples: net 2/5, 8/20; pools 100/200; repair .8/.4; respiratory reserve 50/20; donor/niche differences 25/45; force ratios 5/4; interval mortality .1.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching and examination review: coherent progression and no exact duplicate teaching paragraphs; reviewed keys and distractor reasoning, 12 figures with distinct scientific targets, corrected figure sequence, added source links, comparison tables and dynamic navigation. Compared saved draft to 5.D.01 (14677 words by same token method) and 5.D.11 (14468); comparable narrative structure and depth within distinct subject. Static validation only, no external peer reviewer or interactive browser.

quality.assessment: Internal rubric: deductions for archived third-party SET copy rather than official host, selective primary abstract/full-text access, some recurrence of general experimental reasoning, a subset of straightforward foundational distractors, and static-only browser/visual validation.

navigation.mechanism: Dynamic menu lookup for immediate curriculum neighbors. At publication baseline 5.E.04 already contains a reciprocal dynamic next-node lookup for 5.E.05; 5.E.06 remains unlinked and disabled. No neighbor file overwrite required.
